analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (261,500) vs SMA5/20/50 (265,600/248,825/278,232) — facing short-term resistance, below mid-term support, above long-term support.
· Position relative to SMA100/200 (268,706/205,931) — potential weakening of medium-to-long term trend.
· 52-week position (63.4%) + current price range in historical middle ground.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (47.1→50.5) + neutral range consolidation + lack of direction.
· MACD histogram trajectory (5224.4038→3351.1511) + slowing improvement + weak trend reversal signal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (mid-band 248,825) + band width at 32.44% indicating expansion.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support (240,000) + based on moving averages (SMA20) and Pivot S1.
· Swing resistance (267,000) + approaching SMA5 and upper Bollinger band.
· 5-day/20-day price range pattern — consolidation phase.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.75x) + decreased confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation) + maintaining a wait-and-see approach due to absence of trend reversal signals.
